entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Can I start with your name and order number?
It's Maria Garcia, order number is VF55-21980. I've been a VeloFit customer for a long time, and I was so excited for this new band.

Thank you, Maria. I'm pulling that up now. I understand you're disappointed. To make sure I'm on the right track, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It seems like it's just broken. The main reason I got it was for the heart rate tracking, but it's not working right. And it won't sync my last two runs to the app at all. It just feels... defective.
I see. A band that won't sync properly is certainly frustrating. I'm so sorry you're dealing with that. Let me just quickly check the policy against your purchase date.
Okay, I see you received the VeloBand just 7 days ago. Our company policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? So I can return it? I was so worried because I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work for my marathon training.

Absolutely. Since the item is defective and you're within the 90-day window, I've gone ahead and approved a full refund. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address we have on file for you now.
Wow, thank you so much, David. That's such a relief. You've been really helpful.

You're very welcome, Maria. Just pack the item back in its original box, put that label on, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse scans it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
